title: Metabolites of the gut microbiota may serve as precise diagnostic markers for sarcopenia in the elderly
summary: Random forest models were trained on shotgun metagenomic species and fecal-metabolite features for 32 sarcopenia and 31 control participants. Methods specify fivefold cross-validation and 50/50 train-test evaluation; species-model AUC varied 0.7083–0.8833 across three random validations. This supports exploratory classification in a small cross-sectional cohort, not clinical deployment or causal microbiome claims.
